title: Colimits of fixed-operad algebras and cocontinuous change of coefficients
statement: Use the universes, quasicategories and monoidal infinity categories of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and the generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads of [lem-coef-operadic-algebra-presentability], using only its definitions, not its presentability hypotheses. Let $\mathcal M\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ be a small generalized nonsymmetric infinity operad whose zero-fiber $\mathcal M_{[0]}$ is a space (represented by a Kan complex). For any cocomplete monoidal infinity category $\mathcal V$ whose tensor preserves small colimits separately, let $\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal M}(\mathcal V)$ be the full infinity category of functors $\mathcal M\to\mathcal V^\otimes$ over $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ carrying inert arrows to cocartesian arrows. Then $\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal M}(\mathcal V)$ admits all small colimits. If $\mathcal W$ has the same cocompleteness and tensor hypotheses and $F:\mathcal V\to\mathcal W$ is strong monoidal with underlying functor preserving small colimits, postcomposition induces a functor $F_{*,\mathcal M}:\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal M}(\mathcal V)\to\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal M}(\mathcal W)$ preserving all small colimits, including the empty colimit. In particular its canonical comparison $\operatorname{colim}_K F_{*,\mathcal M}B\to F_{*,\mathcal M}(\operatorname{colim}_K B)$ is an equivalence for each small coherent diagram $B:K\to\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal M}(\mathcal V)$. No presentability assumption on the coefficient categories is imposed.
